result.title: Video Models are Excellent Motion Models
result.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Includes supplementary material
result.summary: Video foundation models have emerged as powerful generators of dynamic visual content, exhibiting remarkable capabilities in synthesizing complex actions and interactions. We argue that these models have also become excellent motion generators, with motion priors that are richer and more general than those learned by dedicated motion models. Their advantage extends beyond visual realism and is manifested in two important aspects: motion naturalness, including coherent body coordination, physical plausibility, and realistic interactions with objects and the environment; and motion scope, encompassing a much broader range of activities and semantic coherence, particularly uncommon, complex, and compound actions. To investigate this position, we introduce a common evaluation framework that compares video and dedicated motion models through three complementary settings: text-only motion generation, reconstruction of video-generated motion from sparse keyframes, and video-based enrichment of motion-model outputs. By converting all outputs into a shared 3D skeletal representation, we evaluate motion naturalness, semantic alignment, action coverage, physical motion characteristics, and fidelity to motion constraints. Our results suggest that video foundation models can generate more natural and semantically meaningful movements, particularly for complex and compound actions. Moreover, we investigate motion-conditioned generation through loose skeletal control, finding that dedicated motion models do not consistently improve video-generated motion, while video models can enrich skeletal animations using sparse motion guidance. Our findings suggest a shift in the role of specialized motion models, from generating complete animations to guiding and controlling the richer motion capabilities already embedded in video foundation models.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文主张视频基础模型已蕴含比专用运动模型更丰富、更通用的运动先验，并构建统一评测框架，将视频模型与专用人体运动模型的输出统一转为 3D 骨架表示，在纯文本生成、稀疏关键帧重建和视频增强运动模型三种设定下比较运动自然度、语义对齐、动作覆盖与物理合理性。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究焦点是人体运动生成质量与动捕式评测，属视频/动画生成方向，未涉及视觉推理中的内部状态、证据筛选、停止决策或 latent 推理轨迹，也未提供可迁移的状态更新或监督线索，故不入选。
